title: Nanette F NDE 749
content:
I awoke on what I think was a ship or airplane and there was a young man sitting next to me. I was lying in a bed. I have never seen this man before but he was smiling at me in a way that put me at ease. I asked him if I was dying and he replied 'No.' He told that he and me that I had a long journey ahead was there to keep me company along the way. When I tried to speak to the other people who were there, I got no response from them. It was as if I was invisible to them. The man who was with me said that he was the only one allowed to speak to me. We didn't talk a lot but it was comforting to have him with me. He gave me drinks of water and food when I needed it. He told me it was almost time to go and I told him that I wanted him to meet my husband; that he would want to thank him for taking care of me. But the man said that he couldn't meet him that it wasn't time. I awoke in intensive care where I had been for five days. I thought that I had been traveling to meet my husband when in fact I had been on life support.

arrival.other_being_detail: A young man the experiencer had never seen before, seated next to her, smiling and comforting; said he was the only one allowed to speak to her and was there to keep her company on a long journey.

environment.environment_other_detail: Experiencer awoke in a bed on what she thought was a ship or airplane; other people were present but did not respond to her.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Perceived travel/journey on a ship or airplane while lying in a bed; inability to communicate with other people present; only one young man allowed to speak to her; then awakening in ICU after five days on life support.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience framed as awakening on a ship or airplane in a bed with a companion; other people present but she seemed invisible to them; companion said he was the only one allowed to speak to her and provided water/food.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'No.' (in response to 'if I was dying'); 'he was the only one allowed to speak to me'; 'I had a long journey ahead'; 'it wasn't time.'
